# Getting Started with `DoExp`

The `DoExp` package is designed to generate Hasse diagrams and Anatomy tables based on datasets from experimental designs. These tools can be used both in the planning and in the analysis of experiments. However, the implemented routines are independent of the response variable.

```{r setup}
library(DoExp)
```
